name: ConfigurableTestDouble
summary: Holds the values to return or expect in fields the test sets during fixture setup, so that one double serves many tests.

roles.name: ConfigurableTestDouble
roles.summary: A double configured at run time rather than written per case. It exists to remove duplication between near-identical doubles, and its cost is stated in its shape: a double with enough knobs becomes a small framework that itself wants testing.
